lesson: CRITICAL: CLOSE the presentation in the GUI before using scripts (python-pptx) to modify slides.
When specifying colors, always use exact RGB or Hex values to ensure precision, rather than relying on visual approximations.
Use scripts for bulk text modifications or slide creation, but always confirm the visual layout matches expectations.
LibreOffice Impress does not have built-in video export functionality. Converting presentations to video requires external tools like screen recording software or third-party converters.
